arguments.sql:
SELECT r.raceId, s.status, COUNT(*) AS result_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT re.driverId) AS drivers,
       COUNT(re.position) AS finishing_positions,
       MIN(re.laps) AS min_laps, MAX(re.laps) AS max_laps
FROM main.races AS r
JOIN main.results AS re ON re.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN main.status AS s ON s.statusId = re.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1957 AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
GROUP BY r.raceId, s.status
ORDER BY s.status

arguments.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN s.status = 'Finished'
          OR s.status GLOB '+[0-9]* Lap'
          OR s.status GLOB '+[0-9]* Laps'
        THEN re.driverId
    END) / COUNT(DISTINCT re.driverId),
    2
) AS classified_finisher_percentage
FROM main.races AS r
JOIN main.results AS re ON re.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN main.status AS s ON s.statusId = re.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1957
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
LIMIT 1
